import io
import json
import os
import tempfile
import unittest

from task_api import TaskAPI


class TaskApiTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.path = os.path.join(self.temp.name, "tasks.db")
        self.app = TaskAPI(self.path)

    def call(self, method, path="/tasks", body=None):
        raw = json.dumps(body or {}).encode()
        seen = []
        result = self.app(
            {
                "REQUEST_METHOD": method,
                "PATH_INFO": path,
                "CONTENT_LENGTH": str(len(raw)),
                "wsgi.input": io.BytesIO(raw),
            },
            lambda status, headers: seen.append((int(status.split()[0]), headers)),
        )
        return seen[0][0], json.loads(b"".join(result))

    def test_create_and_list(self):
        status, task = self.call("POST", body={"title": "Ship sample"})
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        self.assertEqual(self.call("GET")[1][0]["id"], task["id"])

    def test_update(self):
        task = self.call("POST", body={"title": "Old"})[1]
        self.assertEqual(
            self.call("PATCH", "/tasks/" + str(task["id"]), {"title": "New"})[1][
                "title"
            ],
            "New",
        )

    def test_complete(self):
        task = self.call("POST", body={"title": "Finish"})[1]
        self.assertEqual(
            self.call("PATCH", "/tasks/" + str(task["id"]), {"completed": True})[1][
                "completed"
            ],
            1,
        )

    def test_delete(self):
        task = self.call("POST", body={"title": "Remove"})[1]
        self.assertEqual(self.call("DELETE", "/tasks/" + str(task["id"]))[0], 200)
        self.assertEqual(self.call("GET")[1], [])

    def test_validation(self):
        for title in ("", " " * 3, 8, "x" * 201):
            self.assertEqual(self.call("POST", body={"title": title})[0], 400)

    def test_missing(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.call("PATCH", "/tasks/999", {"completed": True})[0], 404)

    def test_invalid_patch_is_atomic(self):
        task = self.call("POST", body={"title": "Original"})[1]
        self.assertEqual(
            self.call(
                "PATCH",
                "/tasks/" + str(task["id"]),
                {"title": "Changed", "completed": "invalid"},
            )[0],
            400,
        )
        self.assertEqual(self.call("GET")[1][0]["title"], "Original")

    def test_restart_persistence(self):
        self.call("POST", body={"title": "Persist"})
        self.app = TaskAPI(self.path)
        self.assertEqual(self.call("GET")[1][0]["title"], "Persist")

    def test_sql_injection_is_data(self):
        title = "'); DROP TABLE tasks; --"
        self.call("POST", body={"title": title})
        self.assertEqual(self.call("GET")[1][0]["title"], title)
